name: RMM vs Intune/MDM Control Ownership Matrix
description: A vendor-neutral buyer map and 18-domain CSV responsibility matrix for assigning monitoring, patching, automation, enrollment, compliance, app delivery, remote support, evidence, and device-retirement ownership across RMM, Microsoft Intune/MDM, remote support, and unified endpoint management. It includes Microsoft Learn references, implementation questions, and safe pilot guidance.
author: Kip Ecklund
